title: AIR Avionics ACD-57 Multi-Function Radio & Altimeter (Official MSFS / Asobo)
company: FlightSim Studio AG (Contracted to Asobo Studio)
summary: Engineered the authentic AIR Avionics / Dittel ACD-57 multi-function 57mm round cockpit instrument under contract from Asobo Studio for integration into official default aircraft in Microsoft Flight Simulator.
highlights: Modeled authentic 57mm round display combining 8.33 kHz VHF COM transceiver, barometric altimeter tape, and transponder display.
Engineered barometric pressure calibration (hPa / inHg), altitude alert warnings, and flight level (FL) readouts.
Integrated menu navigation, frequency databases, and direct SimVar telemetry coupling for official MSFS aircraft.
